content.name: Hannah Okafor
content.title: Lead Front-End Engineer
content.summary: Lead front-end engineer with 15 years in Manchester agencies, transport and broadcasting, now running the web team at a housing association with 38,000 homes. Built the tenant self-service portal that moved 46% of repair requests online. Specialist in accessible design systems and progressive enhancement.

experience.title: Junior Web Developer
bullets: Hand-coded HTML, CSS and JavaScript for 40+ campaign microsites for retail and charity clients.
Converted the agency's fixed-width templates to responsive layouts as mobile traffic passed half of all visits.
Started the studio's cross-browser testing checklist, which halved the number of bugs clients reported after launch.

experience.title: Front-End Developer
bullets: Rebuilt the journey planner and seat picker in Angular, supporting about 120,000 bookings a week.
Cut checkout abandonment on mobile by 14% by simplifying the railcard and fare-choice steps.
Made the booking flow usable without JavaScript as a fallback, after analytics showed 2% of sessions failing to load scripts on train Wi-Fi.
Mentored two apprentices, one of whom became a mid-level developer within two years.

experience.title: Senior Front-End Developer
bullets: Led the front end of a React-based on-demand player used for 3 million monthly streams, adding subtitles controls and audio description switching.
Introduced performance budgets in CI that kept the player's JavaScript bundle under 180 KB despite 30 new features.
Coordinated with the accessibility team on testing with disabled users, resolving 60+ issues found in moderated sessions.

experience.title: Lead Front-End Engineer
bullets: Lead a team of six front-end developers building digital services for 38,000 rented homes across Greater Manchester.
Delivered a tenant self-service portal that now takes 46% of repair requests online, freeing contact-centre staff for urgent and vulnerable callers.
Built a design system based on GOV.UK Design System patterns, adopted by four services and cutting new-page build time by about 40%.
Own a £180,000 annual budget for front-end tooling, testing and contract support.

courses.name: Certified Professional in Accessibility Core Competencies (CPACC)

achievements.title: Speaker, Manchester front-end meetup
achievements.detail: Talk on progressive enhancement for low-connectivity users, attended by around 150 developers.

achievements.title: STEM Ambassador
achievements.detail: Run an annual web-design workshop for Year 9 pupils at two Salford schools.
